question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**shirt**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the context provided, the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3 is indeed a "**shirt**."
 
• The corrected sentence should read:* "And then he took off his **shirt** and played in just his trousers and stockinged feet..."*
 
• The word "**shirt**" refers to an upper garment that covers the upper body. In the passage, Uncle Bob removes his shirt, indicating a change in attire during the described activity, likely a game of tennis or a similar sport.
 
• This action of removing his shirt aligns with the context, describing Uncle Bob's attire while engaged in the activity.

 

**Correct Passage:__** *And you could hardly call it a **game** at all, because Uncle Bob held his **racket** as though he had hold of a shovel, and tried to scoop up every ball that came over the net, even those he should have left for Uncle Ted.
